jia (sdk): heads up — ran into a weird one where VSCode auto-imports point to the CJS entry and users on edge runtimes get TS type errors + runtime: 

omar (devex): can you paste the import and package.json exports?

jia (sdk): minimal repro: user writes `import { createClient } from 'redwood-js'` in an edge function. VSCode inserts path that resolves to the CJS build at runtime. package.json export currently:

jia (sdk): ```json
{
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.cjs",
  "module": "dist/esm/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs",
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs"
    },
    "./package.json": {"default": "./package.json"}
  }
}
```

priya (docs): hmm — that looks standard. what's the TS error?

jia (sdk): TS shows missing types for `createClient` when imported as subpath `redwood-js/edge`. Our edge build didn't expose a subpath d.ts. Runtime: on Vercel Edge the CJS resolution leads to an ESM/CJS interop wrapper which rewires global fetch and breaks our token store — occasional 401 spikes.

omar (devex): two things: 1) typings for subpath, 2) make sure editor auto-imports prefer the ESM path. Editors use package exports + typesVersions to pick.

jia (sdk): proposed quick fixes:
- add `exports./edge` mapping with `types` pointing to `dist/edge.d.ts`
- add `exports.import` top-level and `types` per export entry so TS and node resolver align
- publish a small `redwood-js-edge` alias package? (meh)

priya (docs): can we instead update our sample app and quickstart to show `import { createClient } from 'redwood-js/esm'` or `from 'redwood-js/edge'` so users get the right import in the first place? docs change would help but we should fix package layout too.

typebot: Recommendation: add "exports": { ".": {"import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.cjs","types":"./dist/index.d.ts"},"./edge":{"import":"./dist/esm/edge.mjs","types":"./dist/edge.d.ts"} } and update `typesVersions` to map `*` -> `dist/*`.

jia (sdk): implemented patch in sandbox, verified TS resolves edge.d.ts for `redwood-js/edge`, and VSCode auto-import now prefers `redwood-js/edge`. Still want to harden runtime: replace any setImmediate/nextTick in auth retry with a portable sleep util based on Promise+AbortSignal.

omar (devex): can you open a small PR that updates the sample app imports, adds a note in quickstart, and includes a CI smoke that runs `tsc --noEmit` against the sample using an edge import?

ci-bot: created preview build for samples PR: https://preview.app/vercel/samples/edge-ide-fix (reaction :white_check_mark:)

priya (docs): PR link? i'll add a changelog note about editor auto-imports.

jia (sdk): https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/183 — includes package.json exports fix, new dist/edge.d.ts, and replaced retry timers.

omar (devex): awesome. follow-up: can we add a short troubleshooting section in the SDK FAQ: "Editor auto-imports the wrong entry — check your package exports and prefer the edge entrypoint". I'll file a follow-up issue to centralize dual-publish rules.

jia (sdk): filing issue #4010 with repro and test matrix. thanks everyone.

priya (docs): nice one. will update quickstart before the next release.
